name: HYDRA-UMC-DATALAKE
build: Runs real SQLite-backed store and HTTP API checks; no external database is required by the current implementation.
notes: Real sqlite3-backed time-series store with a real HTTP API (POST /ingest, GET /query), tested and verified end-to-end against real sibling writes. Real, reversible schema migrations (PRAGMA user_version), explicit UTC timestamp formatting (GET /stats/range), and validated, opt-in per-series retention (GET/POST /retention, POST /retention/apply).
